text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "Remarks:"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Valentine's Day is just around the 
corner. If it wouldn't be a bother, would 
it be alright if I gave you some homemade 
sweets?"
"Remarks:"
choice_data_list:
"Not at all, you're not bothering me in 
the least."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
All riiiiiiight!! Let's get started on 
making sweets!!

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text: Ooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's review the steps again. 
Let's organize things to run efficiently, 
like making sure we don't overlap oven 
times.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please take care of me! Um, as for 
me—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, first I have to cut out a whole, 
whole bunch of shapes! Guess I won't be 
using the oven for a while.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Even so... you're making quite 
a lot this year, aren't you, Craft-san?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~, yep! Up until last year, I 
couldn't quite muster enough courage, but— 
I'm in the Senior Class now!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I want to work up the courage to give my 
'I respect you!' chocolates to the seniors 
on the Tiara route!!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Sweep-san goes without saying! And 
Still-san, Ramonu-san, Pearl-san, 
Flight-san, and—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I want to give some to Air Groove-san 
too! Messiah-san, want to come with me 
when I do?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes, gladly. I'd like to hand one to 
Senpai myself, too.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I'm planning to make steamed buns... so I 
won't be needing the oven♪ Thanks for 
organizing everything, Messiah-san!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
No. What about steamed bread for 
Cesario-san... like cocoa flavor?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, just like a Valentine's treat! 
Though I'm planning to make it a bit 
healthier by using soy pulp.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Spe-san was saying that around this time 
of year, the temptation of sweets is just 
so strong that she ends up overeating, so—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to give you something that 
wouldn't become too much of a hassle 
afterwards.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I see. Health-conscious... If that's the 
case, it should suit the stoic Kris 
S-senpai's tastes as well.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Do you think so? Messiah-san, do you 
think so too?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank goodness♪ In that case, I can 
hand it over with confidence.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Then I suppose I'll be the first to use 
the oven? Since I'm starting by baking the 
pie sheets.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. For Heart-san's florentines, she 
likely bakes them first before topping 
them with the almond filling.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Then I'll go first, okay?♪ Fufufu, how 
about I let you eat the very first freshly 
baked one!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I am honored, but... fufu, if word 
gets out that I received such a favor from 
someone as popular as you, walking home at 
night might become rather dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Are these florentines made with pie sheets 
as a shortcut recipe to prepare a large 
batch rivaling Craft-san's?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It seems quite a lot of girls are looking 
forward to receiving a gift from you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
My, you make it sound like none of your 
business! Aren't you looking forward to it 
too?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Of course, giving them to everyone and 
making them happy is something I'm looking 
forward to.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Our gift exchange after this is something 
I've been looking forward to so, so much!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: That makes it an even greater honor.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Alright... now all that's left is the 
wrapping.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Messiah-san's brownies look so delicious~! 
Was that the recipe your mother taught 
you?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Back when I lived at home, I used to 
make them with my mother and sister.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I see~! Yeah, yeah, that classic 
Valentine's vibe is just the best♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: The royal road—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Messiah-san! Are you going to 
wrap them now?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"How about... right! What if we added an 
illustration or something? I actually 
bought some message cards!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"An illustration...? I appreciate the 
offer, but—"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I am not very accustomed to such things. I 
wouldn't want to look ungraceful, so—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Messiah! You know, Cesario's only 
saying that because she's worried about 
you.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Worried? ...What do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh! Don't tell me... you didn't 
know?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: About your Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...So, that means you'll be in the 
Trainer's room on Valentine's Day, right? 
Right?!
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah, just working like usual.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: There, there! ...Or so they say!

text_block_list.name: Junior Trainer
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you very much! Um, err...

text_block_list.name: Junior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'll just drop by for a tiny bit 
then. Um, as soon as I hand this over, 
I'll leave right away!

text_block_list.name: Junior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... See you on the day of the race, 
then. Excuse me!

Just before Valentine's Day, I walked down 
the hallway, tilting my head in 
bewilderment. ...Unbelievably, that was 
already the seventh person.

In the Trainer lounge. Or out in the 
hallways. At the central plaza, and at the 
training grounds. Lately, I've been 
stopped all over the place—

I did wonder, "Could there have been some 
misunderstanding that made them think I 
was utterly obsessed with sweets?" ...but 
apparently that's not the case.

In short—it seems we've become the center 
of attention.

text_block_list.name: Junior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Your skill, your dependable training 
methods— I respect all of it so much...!"

text_block_list.name: Junior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to have a proper chat with you 
sometime! So think of this as a token to 
break the ice, so to speak.

...Now that I think about it, looking at 
my own position again, I truly am 'the 
trainer of an Umamusume who achieved 
spectacular success in the Triple Tiara.'

Just a few years ago, I was a total 
rookie. I took pride in being one of the 
plain, inconspicuous ones whose only 
redeeming quality was being overly 
earnest, but—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Well, in short! Your Trainer is quite 
popular with the ladies.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Cesario and the others and I saw it, you 
know—someone approaching your Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I see...?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...No, but what does that have to do with 
wrapping?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Are you sure you don't mind not 
standing out?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure your Trainer will receive a 
massive amount of chocolates.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Among all of those, though— This one's 
from me! 'Trainer, this brownie right here 
is mine!'"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, aren't you going to appeal to 
them?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Showcasing myself... you say?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (...Amazing.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(So many have truly arrived. Just as 
Heart-san told me...)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
For now... should I just line them up 
here?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ! Trainer, thanks for your hard work.
choice_data_list: Oh, sorry the couch is such a mess!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no. It's not clutter; they're all 
precious gifts, after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Oh, today was a rest day anyway... If you 
don't mind, Trainer, would you like to 
have some tea now?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I also have some sweets that I received 
from Craft-san and the others.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, since it's Valentine's Day after 
all. Let me go ahead and take one first.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Especially you, Trainer, since you have so 
many. Better eat them before the 
expiration date passes.

Replying so, I pick up one of the boxes on 
the sofa... a pale pastel yellow box tied 
with a blue ribbon.
choice_data_list: Starting with yours. Thank you, Messiah.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Huh, ah... No. Um...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I put it there without saying anything, 
and its appearance is... well, rather 
plain, you see.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
......No way. I never expected you would 
understand.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
................I was just... taken by 
surprise.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Truth is, my friends were worried about 
me. While I was making it.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
You've been getting a lot of attention 
lately, so you'll probably receive plenty 
of gifts... Are you sure you don't want to 
make it stand out more?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest... I did consider it for a 
moment. However, I decided against it."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
That box and ribbon... My mother and I 
have always used them whenever we exchange 
gifts.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: It is... my absolute favorite.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"That is why. Even if it is not 
elaborate... I wanted to hand it directly 
to you, just as it is."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...I'm so glad I could give it to you.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...I'm so glad I could give it to you.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, my apologies, that somehow ended up 
tickling me a bit.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I'll go make some tea.

I couldn't help hesitating in my response. 
Worry from friends...? To think that's 
what was being talked about.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I've reboiled the kettle. If you could 
please wait just a little longer—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer? Did something happen?
choice_data_list: There's one thing I want to tell you.
There's one thing I want to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ? ...What could it be?

Stumblingly, searching for words, I still 
speak to her with all my might.

"If I am indeed drawing an almost 
unfitting amount of positive attention."
That's everything.
choice_data_list:
All of it, all of it...it's all thanks to 
you

All of it, all of it...it's all thanks to 
you

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Such a thing...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"That's not true... It's the result of 
your own hard work—"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...is what I would normally be expected to 
report, however.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Just for today. I'll refrain from doing 
so in the living room, at least."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...I feel proud saying, "Indeed, that is 
so."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Trainerâ Happy... Valentine's Day.
